item.title: From Engineer to Founder: Lessons from Raising $120k
item.description:
From Engineer to Founder: Lessons from Raising $120k Link to heading

Recently, my team and I successfully raised $120k in pre-seed funding at a ~$1M valuation through the Antler VN8 Cohort for SENLA for logistics providers.

This journey from embedded systems engineer to technical co-founder taught me several lessons worth sharing.

Building Beyond Your Comfort Zone Link to heading

Transitioning from embedded C++ development in aerospace to full-stack web applications for logistics wasn’t straightforward. The past year involved:

item.title: Building digital license plates for drones at 24
item.description:
It was probably the biggest professional challenge of my career, all as junior engineer. Link to heading

In 2022, I took on a project that would define much of my year: building Remote ID for our drones. For those unfamiliar, Remote ID is the FAA’s new requirement—basically a digital license plate that broadcasts a drone’s identity and location in real-time. Without it, our entire fleet would be grounded. No worries… At that time I was still figuring out how a 401k worked.
